entities.name: Alice Pataxó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alice Pataxó is a Brazilian indigenous climate activist. She gained national and international recognition after participating in the COP26 in Glasgow in 2021 as a spokesperson for the defense of the environment and indigenous rights. Alice was honored as one of the BBC 100 Women in 2022, after Malala Yousafzai nominated her for the award.
